name: @kickside/widgets-icon-picker
title: KickSide Icon Picker
description: Shared Tabler icon picker web component (<wc-icon-picker>) for kickside — the single icon chooser reused across agents, knowledge, skills, and navigation appearance.

wippy.description: Shared picker and form-widget set for kickside — one build in this package produces seven web components served from /kickside-widgets: wc-icon-picker (this wippy block, index.js) plus wc-model-picker, wc-multiselect, wc-channel-picker, wc-connection-picker, wc-component-picker, and wc-schema-form, each its own bundle entry with a view.component registry entry in platform/widgets/src/_index.yaml carrying its full per-tag props schema. All widgets share one contract: the current selection goes in as string attributes (value, or config where a data-flow config form mounts them) and changes come back as DOM CustomEvents read from event.detail. Most emit change — detail {connection_id} (connection), {thread_id} (component), {connection_id, channel_id, channel_name} (channel), {selected, labels} (multiselect) — while the icon and model pickers emit select with the picked name string and the schema form emits config-changed with the merged values object. Data-loading pickers also emit load once ready and error ({message, error}) on a failed fetch; the connection and component pickers mirror change as config-changed, and the component picker can emit created ({thread_id}) from its inline create path. The props below describe only wc-icon-picker (value = selected icon name such as tabler:home, fallback = trigger icon when unset); consult the registry entries for every other tag's attributes.

fallback.description: Icon shown on the trigger when no value is set.
